about: The HorrorStudio panel's cards (editor/build_tab.gd): its categories and, in each, what a card adds. kind part: an HSThing scene of parts/ (it wraps the model it's dropped on, or stands in on its own); preset: a level node of presets/; window: a window put in the selected room's wall; scare: an area and the moment it starts (the Director file). make_parts.py keeps it whole: a part it makes that isn't here comes in under its kind's category.

categories.title: Player
